summary: Glades County, FL tower credited to the Florida Forest Service; its only height in the sources read is an OpenStreetMap tag (60.96 m). No build date, builder history, or condition source found.

agency is the Florida Forest Service

corrections.why: The Forest Lookouts entry gives only county and agency, and OpenStreetMap has no status tag; neither source states the tower stands today.

notes_for_editor: Very thin: a short Forest Lookouts entry (county and agency) and an OSM height tag. Two web searches and a Wikipedia check (Palmdale, Florida) found no tower history. The 60.96 m height is a volunteer map value, not verified. Contact the Florida Forest Service before publishing the status or height as fact.
